summary: With the adoption of the Vision Zero Road Safety Plan, there have been increased requests to my office for speed limit reductions on local roads in Ward 11. -Wall Avenue­- Wall Avenue, which runs between Langside Avenue and Portage Avenue, is a local road with two-way operation; sidewalks are absent on both sides of the road. The legal speed limit is 40 km/hr. In response to a petition submitted to my office for traffic calming, Transportation Services conducted speed and volume counts on the street and determined that the technical warrants for traffic calming were not met; a reduction in the speed limit to 30 km/hr is being sought instead. ­-Henrietta Street­­- Henrietta Street, which runs from Castleton Avenue to the east limit of the road, is a local road with two-way operation and sidewalks on both sides of the road. In 2016, the speed limit on a section of the road was reduced, making the legal speed limit on Henrietta Street, from Runnymede Road to the east limit of the street 40 km/hr; the speed limit on Henrietta Street from Castleton Avenue to Runnymede Road is 50 km/hr. I am requesting that the speed limit on the full length of Henrietta Street from Castleton Avenue to the east limit of the road be reduced to 30 km/hr. -Rockcliffe Boulevard- Rockcliffe Boulevard, from Alliance Avenue to Terry Drive/Woolner Avenue, is a collector road with two-way operation, a…
decided: Etobicoke York Community Council: 1. Directed Transportation Services to reduce the speed limit on the following roads in Ward 11 to 30 km/hr: a. Wall Avenue b. Henrietta Street c. Rockcliffe Boulevard, between Alliance Avenue and Terry Drive/Woolner Avenue d. Guestville Avenue e. Dennis Avenue f. Ralph Street g. Hillborn Avenue.
